preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root of the tree must be an instance of TreeNode or None.
The value to be inserted must be an integer.

postconditions.description: The function must return the root of the modified AVL tree.
The returned tree must be balanced.
The value must be present in the returned tree.

invariants.description: The tree must remain a binary search tree after insertion.
